subject.title: feat(cron): serve cron run history from the task ledger

question: Should the authoritative-read flip be delayed until cron-specific retention and a doctor-owned, in-place legacy migration are included in the same safe upgrade boundary?
rationale: The current two-part rollout intentionally lands the read flip before retention and final migration cleanup, but that ordering can alter or lose existing users' visible history and conflicts with the repository's persistent-state migration policy.

options.title: Require migration-safe rollout
options.body: Keep this PR open and require retention, in-place mirror migration, recovery compatibility, and doctor verification before the ledger becomes authoritative.

options.title: Retain legacy reads temporarily
options.body: Allow the new full-fidelity writes now, but keep run-history and recovery reads on the legacy store until the second migration PR is ready.

options.title: Accept the split rollout
options.body: Merge this part while explicitly accepting temporary duplicate rows, shorter history retention, and database-open migration exposure.

recommendation.title: Require migration-safe rollout
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open and require retention, in-place mirror migration, recovery compatibility, and doctor verification before the ledger becomes authoritative.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the clearest available prior ownership signal for the shipped task-ledger contract affected by this rollout choice.
